scope: 30 exposed development queries (27 code-annotated), 2K/8K, 25 arms, 1 sequential repetition, 1500 timing samples; code-only Graphify; no held-out or agent inference.
decision_blockers: development workload: the decision rule applies only to the frozen held-out set
Insufficient scored queries: frozen pilot/minimum requires 110 per guardrail
No significant reduction in the primary metric
Too many queries with severe quality losses

primary_diagnostic.hypothesis: candidate delivers fewer tokens than the comparator
primary_diagnostic.test: one-sided paired sign-flip permutation on comparator minus candidate

cache_conditions: Fresh indexes on identical frozen source sets; index command prebuilds shared units. Sequential tools, fixed arm order for one repeat; shared warm/uncontrolled OS caches. No concurrent comparative work.
timing_scope: Fresh subprocess: startup, index load, locate ranking, cached unit-index load, body/call and metadata scoring, grouping, current source reads/freshness checks, whole-unit fit checks, fallback window trimming, exact tokenization, rendering and stdout. Index commands prebuild unit cache for all arms. Shared warm/uncontrolled OS caches, one sequential repeat, no latency inference.
timing_limit: One sequential sample, warm/uncontrolled caches, no latency inference.
budget_note: Same requested budgets; raw native Graphify overshoots retained. Scratch path in native headers changes raw tokens; no equal-realized-budget claim.
source_anchor_note: Author-selected exploratory anchors for graf only; Graphify hints do not deliver source ranges. Documentation-task performance unmeasured.
interpretation: Rejected as an improvement on the exposed development pilot: more mean output tokens at both budgets versus v50, one code-file recall loss at2K (fastify-03), no code-file gains and no exploratory source-anchor gains at either budget. No source evidence gained versus the simpler structural prefix. The synthetic functionality works, but this data does not support the retrieval hypothesis. Retain opt-in for reproducibility; do not promote. No post-result algorithm tuning.
